domtoren.name: Dom Tower
domtoren.slogan: 465 steps up to the whole of Utrecht.
domtoren.line: Begun in 1321 to a design by John of Hainaut, the tower took until 1382 to finish and has stood alone since the nave collapsed in 1674.

dehaar.name: Kasteel de Haar
dehaar.slogan: A ruin reborn as a fairytale, Rothschild money and all.
dehaar.line: Pierre Cuypers spent some twenty years rebuilding it into a castle of 200 rooms and 30 bathrooms.

schroderhuis.name: Rietveld Schröder House
schroderhuis.slogan: Slide a wall, change the house.
schroderhuis.line: Built in 1924 for Truus Schröder and her three children, it became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2000.

centraalmuseum.name: Centraal Museum
centraalmuseum.slogan: Rietveld chairs, medieval saints and Miffy across the street.
centraalmuseum.line: Founded in 1838, it also runs the Miffy Museum opposite and the Rietveld Schröder House.

koppelpoort.name: Koppelpoort
koppelpoort.slogan: A gate that straddles both the street and the river.
koppelpoort.line: Built between 1380 and 1425, it combines a land gate and a water gate and repelled an attack in 1427.
